subject.title: [Bug]: WebChat can render assistant reply before user prompt and duplicate inbound messages

question: Should maintainers keep this as a combined concrete repro, split it between the WebChat render-order tracker and duplicate user-turn persistence lane, or close it as a duplicate after copying the unmatched evidence elsewhere?
rationale: The issue spans two active root-cause families and automation cannot safely choose the permanent owner boundary without maintainers deciding how to preserve the reporter's unique combined evidence.

options.title: Keep Open As Combined Repro
options.body: Keep this issue open while routing render-order evidence to issue 98001 and duplicate inbound persistence evidence to PR 80670 or the duplicate-transcript umbrella.

options.title: Split Then Close
options.body: Copy the duplicated-inbound evidence to the duplicate-transcript lane and close this as a duplicate of issue 98001 only if maintainers decide the visual ordering problem is the canonical user-facing symptom.

options.title: Revive A Narrow Persistence Fix
options.body: Use PR 80670 as source material for a smaller current-main replacement only after maintainers accept the eager persistence/suppression design.

recommendation.title: Keep Open As Combined Repro
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while routing render-order evidence to issue 98001 and duplicate inbound persistence evidence to PR 80670 or the duplicate-transcript umbrella.
